data.name: Threadstorm
data.detailed_description:
In Threadstorm, you climb into your tank and dive into fast-paced top-down battles filled with barrages of fire, evasive maneuvers, and tactical duels. Every round is a challenge: position yourself strategically, use cover, dodge enemy fire, and strike back the moment your opponent makes a mistake.

In competitive multiplayer, it’s not just about who shoots faster. Choose from different tank classes and find the playstyle that suits you: the balanced all-rounder, the heavily armored tank, the agile speed tank, the high-damage power build, the precise sniper, or the aggressive laser tank. Each class brings its own strengths, weaknesses, and special abilities, such as Dash or Shield.

Through Steam lobbies, you can create matches, join them via lobby code, and compete against other players in Deathmatch. Kills, deaths, the scoreboard, and leaderboards ensure that every round counts and that you can compare your progress with others.

Even outside of multiplayer battles, Threadstorm offers progression and variety: collect coins, unlock new weapons, upgrade your tank with skills, and fight your way through levels filled with waves of enemies, items, and power-ups. Whether you hold the front line defensively, strike from a distance, or race through the arena at high speed—your build determines how you survive the storm.

data.short_description: Threadstorm is a competitive top-down tank shooter where precise aiming, quick decision-making, and smart class selection determine victory or defeat. Battle your way through explosive skirmishes, upgrade your gear, and prove yourself against other players in multiplayer mode.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel or AMD processor, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 or similar)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
